title: Zesty Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: A spicy and crumbly Mediterranean dish featuring yogurt and caramelized flavors, perfect for a low-calorie friendly date night dinner.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
While the kebabs are cooking, caramelize the dates in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Serve the kebabs hot with the caramelized dates and a side of roasted vegetables.
Garnish with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
